summary.text: As HHS Secretary, Robert F. Kennedy Jr. has said HHS is already using AI to manage health care data and that early AI introductions have quickened the clinical trial process. He has described deploying AI to detect fraud in real time and stop improper payments before they leave the Treasury. He has promoted harnessing AI for health care innovation, including rural care, pediatric cancer research, and improved diagnostics. He has also said HHS is making itself a template for AI utilization and called for unleashing AI innovation in health care while opposing a regulatory cartel.
